g.text: with Upgrade and existing auth context
validate existing private-key or JWT auth
reject business query and validate Upgrade
and replace an old same-Pod connection
redact Tool secrets and bound details
store full redacted oversized Tool results
[transport disconnects while run is active on the same Pod]
resolve existing Session and increment generation
replace old connection; atomic subscribe and snapshot
partial Message or null, open contents, active tools
mark old RunRecord and Message interrupted
Open block tails before text_end, thinking_end,
or toolcall_end are not guaranteed to persist.
No cross-Pod run continuation is promised.
Suppressed thinking content uses redacted placeholders.
Snapshot response is sent before post-cursor deltas.
Typed structured delta is a protocol v2 invariant.
Methods are chat.send, chat.steer, chat.abort, chat.history,
chat.steer is text-only in service API v1.
The wss URI is an establishment request.
Before HTTP 101, failures use HTTP status.
After HTTP 101, messages are WebSocket Frames.
HTTP Upgrade does not create a Runtime Session.
Service API v1 and Frame protocol v2 evolve independently.
Frame id and tool_call_id are local correlations.
